title: Migrate Waystation's runtime contract to Bun 1.4.0
description: Establish Bun 1.4.0 as Waystation's tested and declared runtime without adopting optional Bun 1.4 product features yet. Stage the exact Bun 1.4.0 Windows binary beside Bun 1.3.14, capture both versions and revisions, preserve a rollback path, update the package/runtime contract and Bun types, regenerate the lockfile deliberately, and prove that every existing source-mode surface still behaves correctly. Audit the Bun 1.4 breaking changes that matter to this repository: lockfile compatibility, the Node 26 compatibility target, compiled-executable config autoloading, Bun.spawn/Bun.spawnSync, Bun.serve, fetch, bun:sqlite, and bun:test semantics.
acceptance: The Bun 1.3.14 baseline and staged Bun 1.4.0 version/revision, verification results, and rollback locations are recorded in the task thread before the canonical Bun binary is changed.
package.json declares packageManager bun@1.4.0, requires Bun >=1.4.0 <1.5, and pins @types/bun to 1.4.0; bun.lock is regenerated intentionally and its lockfile-version change is reviewed.
Bun 1.4.0 successfully consumes the pre-migration lockfile with --frozen-lockfile before dependency metadata is changed, and a fresh install from the migrated lockfile is reproducible.

The Bun 1.4 breaking-change audit covers lockfile rollback, Node 26 compatibility, compile-time package/tsconfig autoloading, spawn behavior, Bun.serve/fetch behavior, bun:sqlite lifecycle behavior, and bun:test matcher behavior; any required compatibility fixes have regression tests.
Under the staged Bun 1.4.0 binary, bun test, bun run typecheck, bun run check, source sync --views, and validate --project --views all exit successfully.

Source-mode smoke tests cover the CLI, MCP stdio server, dashboard API/server, Git subprocess calls, SQLite reindex/reopen, and concurrent ledger mutation paths without raw stacks or CommandResult regressions.

AGENTS.md, README.md, and runtime/release/distribution documentation present Bun 1.4.0 as current; the old bun-stack spike remains clearly identified as historical evidence rather than being silently rewritten.
No Bun 1.4-only product feature such as JSONL parsing, Markdown rendering, PTYs, cron, or embedded dashboard assets is coupled into this compatibility task.
notes: Do not run an in-place bun upgrade as the first step. Use an explicit side-by-side Bun 1.4.0 path until compatibility is green, and keep the Bun 1.3.14 binary plus the matching pre-migration package.json/bun.lock available for rollback. The official Bun 1.4 breaking-change inventory is https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/28792. This task gates both Bun 1.4 feature-adoption tasks.
